svg.title: Where the analyzer looked
svg.desc: For each of 10 hard positives, the turns the analyzer cited for any construct it marked present or uncertain, the gold evidence turns, and the turn where the conversation stops matching its hard-negative pair.
svg.text: 10 hard positives, one analyzer run each. Shaded = turns after the split from the matched negative (which the analyzer cleared).
